about: Office font -> free look-alike, measured. See docs/format.md. o: options, metric-compatible first then measured rank; f family, m metric-compatible (1/0), s size factor (apply only when m=0), w width at the same size, l line factor; pkg Arch package, gf google/fonts dir, gh GitHub owner/repo/dir. wt: weight in the Office family name. va: [ascent, descent, gap] em as Windows lays it out. xm: [x-height, cap height, sentence width] em. c: class s/r/m/h/d. aw: kerned advance per character (em) over the corpus in docs/format.md, [regular, bold, italic], DirectWrite. Data: office-font-map by JesusLovesYou1013, CC BY-SA 4.0.
